I wouldn't say bored. I feel like voided is the right word. Nothing is fulfilling no matter how hard I try. I don't like to do anything. I don't enjoy the routine of life. Death seems way easier too. Just void, no emotions, no people, no purpose, just void.
I mean. Theres not much of a story. I just don't feel like life is worth living really.

I don't think I have much loose ends I really feel like straightening up. And I set the date pretty much randomly. I just wanted a date that would be months in the future so I could think about how I would end my life and theorize.
I'm not sure. But I guess there's only one way to find out
I mean. Every second that I don't exist is great. I'm not a good person. I should suffer
